description: This file is a shell script used as a test utility for Git, specifically testing reference pattern globbing and related behaviors in rev-parse, rev-list, and other Git commands. It sets up various refs, tags, and configurations, and runs tests comparing expected outputs to actual Git command outputs.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message by writing to a file 'foo', adding it to Git, and committing.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Runs Git commands with different arguments, compares their outputs to ensure they match expected results.
